claim: Raptor is 99% likely to wildcard in Gameweek 4, seeing it as a chance to jump off some of his initial picks that haven't worked.
quote: I'm 99% likely to wildcard in Gameweek 4. I just think it's a good opportunity to jump off some of the initial picks that didn't work

claim: Raptor cites Chelsea's home fixture against Hull as one of the notable GW4 fixture swings supporting his wildcard timing.
quote: there are also some notable fixture swings as well, such as Chelsea at home to Hull

claim: Raptor recommends Gameweek 6, after the international break, as the next-best wildcard timing for viewers who don't want to wildcard in GW4.
quote: If you don't like Gameweek 4, I think the next best opportunity is probably Gameweek 6 after the international break.

claim: Hull City are the only Premier League team yet to concede a goal this season, but have conceded 4.9 xG.
quote: Hull City are now the only team in the Premier League to concede zero goals so far this season, but they have conceded 4.9 xG.

claim: Raptor expects Hull's underlying defensive numbers to catch up even if Tzolakis keeps up his brilliant form, predicting they start conceding goals in Gameweek 4 against Chelsea.
quote: even if Salah keeps up his brilliant form, I do expect them to start conceding goals soon, and I think that could start in Gameweek 4 with Chelsea

claim: Raptor is targeting the Chelsea-Hull fixture and likes Rogers, João Pedro and Palmer for it.
quote: I still would really target this fixture against Hull at home, and I like all of Rogers, Joao Pedro, and Palmer.

claim: On his own wildcard, Raptor plans to own all three of Rogers, João Pedro and Palmer.
quote: On wildcard, I think I'll have all three of them

claim: If forced to pick only two of the three Chelsea attackers, Raptor would lean towards João Pedro and Cole Palmer over Rogers.
quote: if you're to only choose two, I still would lean towards Joao Pedro and Cole Palmer

claim: Raptor says it's absolutely fine to sell Bruno Fernandes this week in order to get in to Cole Palmer.
quote: yes, I think that is a good transfer, and it's absolutely fine to sell Bruno

claim: Over the next couple of weeks Raptor says he'd marginally prefer to own Cole Palmer rather than Bruno Fernandes.
quote: over the next couple of weeks, I'd marginally prefer to have Cole Palmer

claim: Raptor says Manchester City's squad rotation continues to be heavy even without the old 'Pep Roulette' framing.
quote: Despite the fact we no longer have Pep Roulette, Manchester City rotation continues to be rife.

claim: Man City rotation is rife: Foden was benched in GW3 while Cherki started and was subbed early, and Raptor sees the two competing for one position.
quote: it's Phil Foden that's benched, and Riyad Mahrez that starts, but those two are competing for one position, and we saw Mahrez getting an early sub

claim: Raptor also flags Ndiaye and Enzo as further Man City midfield options complicating the rotation picture.
quote: You then have Injai and Enzo Fernández signing.

claim: Doku will eventually return from injury for Man City.
quote: Doku will eventually return from injury, too.

claim: Raptor recommends avoiding all Man City attackers except Erling Haaland given the rotation risk elsewhere in the front line.
quote: I just think I would absolutely avoid Man City attackers unless their name is Erling Haaland.

claim: Raptor likes Barry (Everton) at 5.6m as a cheap forward option with good fixtures, noting he's Everton's only senior striker.
quote: I really like Tiyana Barry at 5.6 million. The fixtures are great, and he's Everton's only senior striker.

claim: Raptor notes Wissa has been good to start the season.
quote: Yoane Wissa, we know has been good to start the season

claim: Raptor lists Wissa as one of three cheap-forward options with good fixtures.
quote: If you're looking for a cheap forward with good fixtures, I think three options have emerged.

claim: Gonzalo (Fulham) has a favourable run over the next five weeks, playing Ipswich, Hull and Coventry.
quote: Gonzalo García, who in the next five weeks has all of Ipswich, Hull, and Coventry to play, and could be a really nice differential

claim: Raptor rates Gonzalo (Fulham) as a nice potential differential cheap-forward pick.
quote: could be a really nice differential

claim: Raptor notes basically every Premier League team plays midweek in the EFL Cup or their European competition before the GW4 deadline.
quote: basically every single Premier League team will be playing midweek in either the EFL Cup or their respective European competitions which do start in this midweek

claim: Raptor recommends avoiding early transfers this week unless a price rise forces your hand, since midweek cup/European games are still to come.
quote: I would 100% be avoiding early transfers if you can help it and you're not going to be priced out.

claim: Raptor advises watching midweek results and performances to see who is getting minutes before finalising transfers.
quote: keep an eye on those results, performances, and see who is getting minutes midweek
